Containers.Name: FreeSize
Containers.Description:
Where the space goes on your Unraid server: the array and pools per share and per disk, without waking sleeping disks; what keeps disks spun up; a permissions report; and moving shares between disks with checked copies. Docker and VMs: what's safe to remove, what to check first, and what's in use and never offered. Deleting moves things to a quarantine on the same disk, where they can be put back; nothing is deleted until you empty it, and nothing is ever deleted automatically.
Paired with a FreeSize Hub (the freesize-hub container, or anywhere Docker runs), the server reports its disks, scans, shares, Docker and VMs to one dashboard beside your PCs and phones. The Hub can only ask: each request is shown, with every path, on the approver phone you choose on the server itself, never from the dashboard.
Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later. Runs at the lowest CPU and disk priority and stops with the array.
